player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta Hungador {player_id} den Connect Four.
Bo simbolo di disk: {symbol}.
Tablero di hunga tin {num_rows} fila i {num_cols} column.
Hungadonan ta tuma turno pa laga nan disk den un di e columnnan (0 te {end_col}).
E promé ku ta konekta (nan mes) kuater disk vertikal, horizontal o diagonal ta gana.
Na bo turno, entrada e número di column den kurchi pa hasi bo move.
Pa ehempel: '[col 4]' o '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: E tabla di wega no ta visibel pa hungadó.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hungador {player_id}, Format di akshon invalido. Format esperá: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Hungador {player_id}, Akshon invalido. Column {col} ta fuera di limit.
invalid_move.already_full: Hungador {player_id}, Akshon invalido. Column {col} ta komplet.

action.dropped_disk: Hungador {player_id} a laga nan disk ({player_symbol}) den column {col}.

outcome.win: E hungadó {player_id} ta gana dor di konektá kuater!
outcome.draw: E wega a terminá den un empate.
